capability: Order payment status: an order's paid or unpaid state, tracked and changed apart from its order status (Zid Payment Status / حالة الدفع, Bulk Payment Status Update / تغيير حالة الدفع بالجملة, order.payment_status.update)
note: Only Zid shows it so far, as a place of its own: its own webhook topic order.payment_status.update (ZD-S-0722), apart from order.status.update (ZD-I-0058), and its own plan lines under Payments / الدفع (ZD-S-0723, ZD-S-0724). Not CM-ORD-003, the stages an order is set to, nor CM-PAY-020, the payment transactions on an order: Zid's statement gives the state's values (paid, unpaid, with unpaid including pending, refunded and voided, ZD-S-0725), not a transaction. The anchor cites Salla's event order.payment.updated (SA-S-1583) and Shopify's topic orders/paid (SH-I-0535) in CM-ORD-001; the back-fill decides whether they show this.
